sources.finding: The repository pins 7.7.2. Its published release changes Quartz registration on .NET10; no package upgrade is selected by this review. Latest website samples can differ from this pin.

Pinned server builder exposes authorization-code flow, endpoint configuration, PKCE requirement, issuer and signing/encryption credentials. Reuse framework protocol validation and token handling rather than custom cryptography.
Authorization/token passthrough occurs after framework processing. Keep HTTPS requirement; application must still apply Tunner session, Account and Product authority.
Framework separates endpoint, grant-type, response-type and scope permissions. Keep these checks enabled; validate Tunner Product/environment/Relationship independently.
Keep token storage enabled. Revocable artifacts do not alone establish immediate resource-server revocation; token-entry validation or introspection is required for current status.
Published IETF BCP240, January2025. Use authorization-code protection, exact registered redirects, PKCE and least privilege; do not introduce implicit or password grants.
Published standards-track revocation protocol; enforce authenticated client/token ownership and approved grant effects, without asserting Product-local session termination.
Published standards-track introspection protocol; active status and disclosed metadata require current authorization, not mere successful token decryption.

findings: Flow39 supplies Product/client/environment/redirect/PKCE/scopes/requested-assurance validation; Product-origin request is explicit ProductRelationship activation intent, distinct from membership and entitlements.
Flow41 separates immediate Tunner denial, policy-controlled grant revocation, signed/versioned propagation, Product acknowledgements and Product-local sessions.

Existing Product registry/Relationship implementation was not found in scoped modules. Use explicit current owner contracts and fail closed when providers are absent; synthetic tests do not qualify production owners.

initial_increment: Real authorization-code plus PKCE authorization/redeem roundtrip using existing OpenIddict stores, Tunner session authority and transaction/outbox. Then refresh, introspection, revocation and compromised-session cases under explicit qualified lifecycle policy; no substitute custom OAuth implementation.
production_inputs_not_selected: Product registry/environment/Relationship authority and enabled propagation contracts
support_boundary: Pinned API source was verified. This review does not assert a vendor support/EOL date or new dependency advisory qualification. Normal dependency/SBOM/security gates precede qualification; no packages installed yet.
external_activity: Read-only official documentation and FigJam; no provider authentication, discovery/JWKS fetch, code redemption, publication or source-document edit.
